segments.snp4.2:1.1: Satto guhāyaṃ bahunābhichanno, tiṭṭhaṃ naro mohanasmiṃ pagāḷho;
segments.snp4.2:1.3: Dūre vivekā hi tathāvidho so, kāmā hi loke na hi suppahāyā.
segments.snp4.2:2.1: Icchānidānā bhavasātabaddhā, te duppamuñcā na hi aññamokkhā;
segments.snp4.2:2.3: Pacchā pure vāpi apekkhamānā, imeva kāme purimeva jappaṃ.
segments.snp4.2:3.1: Kāmesu giddhā pasutā pamūḷhā, avadāniyā te visame niviṭṭhā;
segments.snp4.2:3.3: Dukkhūpanītā paridevayanti, kiṃsū bhavissāma ito cutāse.
segments.snp4.2:4.1: Tasmā hi sikkhetha idheva jantu, yaṃ kiñci jaññā visamanti loke;
segments.snp4.2:4.3: Na tassa hetū visamaṃ careyya, appañhidaṃ jīvitamāhu dhīrā.
segments.snp4.2:5.1: Passāmi loke pariphandamānaṃ, pajaṃ imaṃ taṇhagataṃ bhavesu;
segments.snp4.2:5.3: Hīnā narā maccumukhe lapanti, avītataṇhāse bhavābhavesu.
segments.snp4.2:6.1: Mamāyite passatha phandamāne, maccheva appodake khīṇasote;
segments.snp4.2:6.3: Etampi disvā amamo careyya, bhavesu āsattimakubbamāno.
segments.snp4.2:7.1: Ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho;
segments.snp4.2:7.3: Yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī [na limpatī (syā. ka.)] diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.
segments.snp4.2:8.1: Saññaṃ pariññā vitareyya oghaṃ, pariggahesu muni nopalitto;
segments.snp4.2:8.3: Abbūḷhasallo caramappamatto, nāsīsatī [nāsiṃsatī (sī. syā. pī.)] lokamimaṃ parañcāti.

lines: 781-2. Evaṃ paṭhamagāthāya “dūre vivekā tathāvidho”ti sādhetvā dutiyagāthāya ca tathāvidhānaṃ sattānaṃ dhammataṃ āvikatvā idāni nesaṃ pāpakammakaraṇaṃ āvikaronto “kāmesu giddhā”ti gāthamāha.
Tassattho – te sattā kāmesu paribhogataṇhāya giddhā pariyesanādimanuyuttattā pasutā sammohamāpannattā pamūḷhā avagamanatāya maccharitāya buddhādīnaṃ vacanaṃ anādiyanatāya ca avadāniyā.
Kāyavisamādimhi visame niviṭṭhā antakāle maraṇadukkhūpanītā “kiṃsū bhavissāma ito cutāse”ti paridevayantīti.
Yasmā etadeva, tasmā hi sikkhetha … pe … māhu dhīrāti.
Idāni ye tathā na karonti, tesaṃ byasanappattiṃ dassento “passāmī”ti gāthamāha.
Atha vā bhavābhavesūti bhavabhavesu, punappunabhavesūti vuttaṃ hoti.
